description_en: Sets the column encryption permissions for multiple database accounts
description_zh: 批量设置数据库账号列加密权限
name: UpdateDataMaskingUsers

parameters.help_en: The cloud product type identifier. Valid values: 5: RDS. 8: POLARDB. 27: PolarDBX2. If specified together with ProductCode, the values must match
parameters.help_zh: 云产品类型标识。5：RDS；8：POLARDB；27：PolarDBX2。与 ProductCode 同时指定时应对应
parameters.name: product_id

parameters.help_en: The cloud product code. Column encryption supports RDS, POLARDB, and PolarDBX2. If ProductId is also provided, the two parameters must match
parameters.help_zh: 云产品编码。列加密支持 RDS、POLARDB、PolarDBX2；如同时传入 ProductId，二者必须对应
parameters.name: product_code

parameters.help_en: The column encryption access permissions. Valid values: fullAccess: plaintext access. restrictedAccess: restricted access. noneAccess: prohibits decryption. noneAccess applies only to RDS MySQL instances whose current effective key pattern is client_key
parameters.help_zh: 列加密访问权限。fullAccess：明文访问；restrictedAccess：受限访问；noneAccess：禁止解密。noneAccess 仅适用于 RDS MySQL 且当前生效密钥模式为 client_key 的实例
parameters.name: auth_role

fields.help_en: The name of the database account. Obtain the value from Items[].AccountName in the records returned by ListDataAssetAccounts and pass it as a string exactly as it is. Do not pass Items[].Id. Each AccountId must correspond to the InstanceId in the same item. Accounts with the same name in different instances are considered different targets
fields.help_zh: 数据库账号名称。请从 ListDataAssetAccounts 返回的记录中取 Items[].AccountName，并原样作为字符串传入；不要传 Items[].Id。每项 AccountId 必须与同一项 InstanceId 对应，同名账号在不同实例中是不同目标
fields.name: account_id

fields.help_en: The database instance identity. You can obtain the value from Items[].InstanceId returned by ListDataMaskingInstances
fields.help_zh: 数据库实例标识，可从 ListDataMaskingInstances 的 Items[].InstanceId 获取
fields.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The list of database accounts for which you want to set permissions
parameters.help_zh: 待设置权限的数据库账号列表
parameters.name: user_list

parameters.help_en: The language of the response description. Valid values: zh: Chinese. en: English
parameters.help_zh: 响应说明的语言。zh：中文；en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The processing method for the permission expiration time. Valid values: PRESERVE: retains the original expiration time. CLEAR: clears the expiration time. SET: sets the expiration time to the value of ExpireTime. Default value: PRESERVE. Only fullAccess supports setting an expiration time
parameters.help_zh: 权限到期时间的处理方式。PRESERVE：保留原到期时间；CLEAR：清除到期时间；SET：设置 ExpireTime。默认 PRESERVE。仅 fullAccess 支持设置有效期
parameters.name: expire_time_operation

parameters.help_en: The expiration time of the plaintext access permissions. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds since 00:00:00 UTC on January 1, 1970. Specify this parameter only when ExpireTimeOperation is set to SET. The value must be later than the current time and no greater than 2145953410000. The server saves the value with second-level precision. Do not specify this parameter when ExpireTimeOperation is set to PRESERVE or CLEAR
parameters.help_zh: 明文访问权限到期时间。自 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC 起的 Unix 时间戳，单位为毫秒。仅 ExpireTimeOperation=SET 时填写，必须晚于当前时间且不大于 2145953410000；服务端按秒精度保存。PRESERVE 或 CLEAR 时不传
parameters.name: expire_time

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which can be used to locate this API call
RequestId.description_zh: 请求标识，可用于定位本次 API 调用
